reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Labeling requirements for new and secondhand bedding
headings.reviewNote: Mandates clear labels distinguishing all-new white labels from secondhand yellow labels and requires compliance with department rules.

headings.title: Prohibition against label alteration or removal
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits removing, defacing, or altering bedding labels to defeat statutory requirements.

headings.title: Permanent affixation requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires required bedding labels to be permanently affixed.

headings.title: False or misleading label statements prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits making false or misleading statements on bedding labels required by statute.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1999/2001 history note; confirmed white all-new vs yellow secondhand bedding labels, removal/alteration ban, permanent affixation, and false-statement prohibition.

headings.title: Department approval of label specifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires health and senior services director approval for label form, size, fabric, and statements.

headings.title: Placement and conspicuous attachment of label
headings.reviewNote: Requires secure attachment of label at manufacturing site in conspicuous place for inspection.

headings.title: Single-side printing and advertising prohibition
headings.reviewNote: Restricts label printing to one side and prohibits advertising matter or unauthorized text.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1999/2001 history note; confirmed health director label approval, conspicuous manufacturer-site attachment, and single-side/no-advertising rules.

headings.title: Product testing and premises inspections
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department to conduct random bedding tests and manufacturer, renovator, or sanitizer premises inspections.

headings.title: Embargo, recall, and condemnation of noncompliant bedding
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department to embargo, recall, condemn, or destroy bedding upon probable cause of violation.

headings.title: Permit sanctions, misdemeanor penalty, and restitution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes permit denial, suspension, or revocation, establishes class A misdemeanor penalty, and allows restitution.

headings.title: Temporary restraining orders for immediate health threats
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department petitions for temporary restraining orders against violations creating immediate public health threats.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for false new-material labeling
headings.reviewNote: Establishes class A misdemeanor penalty for knowingly selling or labeling secondhand bedding as all new.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections and 1999/2001 history note; confirmed random testing/inspection, embargo/condemnation, permit sanctions/class A misdemeanor/restitution, health-threat TROs, and false new-material mislabeling penalty.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and subject matters
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department rulemaking governing label specifications, permit procedures, hearings, and compliance standards.

headings.title: Rules incorporating uniform standards and testing procedures
headings.reviewNote: Permits department rules to incorporate by reference uniform standards, norms, or testing procedures issued or accepted by recognized government, public, or industry organizations.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1999/2001 history note; replaced hallucinated chapter 536 nonseverability heading/note in subsection 2 with incorporation-by-reference of uniform standards and testing procedures.

headings.title: Sanitization requirement for secondhand material
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits manufacturing bedding from secondhand material unless sanitized or cleaned by department-approved method.

headings.title: Mandatory label wording and sanitization details
headings.reviewNote: Requires clear label with specific statutory sanitization statement, treatment methods, date, and permit information.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1999 enactment note; confirmed secondhand-material sanitization requirement and mandatory sanitization disclosure label wording and four required details.
